description: This Java source file defines the class 'BlockedNamespaces' which manages a distributed data structure (an ORSet) to track blocked namespaces across a cluster using Akka cluster features. It provides methods to add, remove, and check for namespaces in the distributed set with appropriate replication consistency configurations.

classes.name: BlockedNamespaces
classes.description: Manages distributed tracking of blocked namespaces in an Akka clustered environment using replicated ORSet.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Returns an instance of BlockedNamespaces with default configuration for a given ActorSystem.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BlockedNamespaces with a specified configuration.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a namespace is stored in the local replica within the configured timeout.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a namespace to the distributed set across all replicas.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a namespace from the distributed set across all replicas.
